description: Phase 8: pure offline integer-pesewa learning functions; explicitly not an accounting library or currency type

cases.name: closing_cash_pesewas
cases.source:
dwumadie ka_akonta(opening, sales, refunds, expenses)
  sanma opening + sales - refunds - expenses
awiei
ka ka_akonta(250000, 182500, 12500, 151750)

cases.name: receipts_and_refunds
cases.source:
dwumadie ka_akonta(opening, received, refunded, paid)
  sanma opening + received - refunded - paid
awiei
ka ka_akonta(0, 10000, 2000, 3000)
ka ka_akonta(500, 0, 500, 0)

cases.name: preserve_transfer_total
cases.source:
ma store = 75000
ma bank = 25000
ma transfer = 12000
ma before = store + bank
ma store = store - transfer
ma bank = bank + transfer
ka store
ka bank
ka before == store + bank

cases.name: no_negative_cash_guard
cases.source:
dwumadie can_pay(balance, payment)
  sanma payment >= 0 ne payment <= balance
awiei
ka can_pay(1200, 1300)
ka can_pay(1200, 1200)
ka can_pay(1200, -2)

cases.name: currency_tags_do_not_mix
cases.source:
dwumadie same_currency(left_code, right_code)
  sanma left_code == right_code
awiei
ka same_currency("GHS", "GHS")
ka same_currency("GHS", "USD")

cases.name: signed_adjustments_and_zero
cases.source:
dwumadie final_amount(start, adjustment)
  sanma start + adjustment
awiei
ka final_amount(5000, -5000)
ka final_amount(-3000, 3000)
ka final_amount(0, 0)
